Name: Edit Mode
Description: Specifies how the variable is used in the node. 'Consume' reads the value of an existing variable, while 'Modify' changes the value or applies an expression to the variable.

Flubs.Name: Consume
Flubs.Description: Reads and uses the value of the specified variable without altering it.

Flubs.Name: Modify
Flubs.Description: Applies an expression or new value to the variable, updating its value for subsequent nodes.

Name: Variable Name
Description: The name of the variable to consume or modify. This should match the variable defined elsewhere in the graph or macro.

Name: Expression
Description: An optional mathematical or logical expression to apply when modifying the variable. Used only in 'Modify' mode.

Name: Default Value
Description: The value to use if the specified variable is not set or available. Ensures the node has a fallback value.
